verdict_text:
# REJECT

## Finding: doubled `charset` on `/llms.txt`
`api/llms_txt.py` returns `Response(..., mimetype="text/plain; charset=utf-8")`, which makes Werkzeug append its own charset and yields a doubled `Content-Type`.

### Fix
Use bare `text/plain` as the mimetype.
